messages.subject: How to create responsive images in Shiny App
messages.subject_clean: How to create responsive images in Shiny App
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

I need create a responsive image in my shiny app.
I have a banner image in the titlePanel and i want its size to change when the app is viewed from a mobile device (i attach mobile screenshot).

My code:

shinyUI(fluidPage(theme = "bootstrap.css",
                  tags$head(
                    tags$link(rel = "stylesheet", type = "text/css", href = "bootstrap.css")
                  ),responsive=TRUE,
  # Application title
  titlePanel(tags$img(src="Bannercs.png", alt="Nature", class="responsive"), windowTitle = "A/B test parameters"),

  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(
      h4("Panel de datos"),
      numericInput("cr", "Métrica actual %", 2, min = 0, max = 100,step = 0.1),
      numericInput("ei", "Diferencia objetivo %", 15, min = 1, max = 100,step = 1),
      radioButtons("hypo", "Hipótesis",
                   c("Bidireccional" = "two.sided",
                     "Unidireccional" = "one.sided")),
      radioButtons("power", "Potencia",
                   c("80%" = "0.80",
                     "85%" = "0.85",
                     "90%" = "0.90",
                     "95%" = "0.95",
                     "NULL" = "NULL")),
      radioButtons("conf", "Nivel de Confianza",
                   c("90%" = "0.90",
                     "95%" = "0.95",
                     "99%" = "0.99",
                     "NULL" = "NULL")),
      numericInput("n", "Tamaño muestra", NULL,min = 0, max = 10000000,step = 1000),
      numericInput("n_sem", "Cantidad de usuarios del sitio por semana", 1000,min = 0, max = 10000000,step = 1000)
    ),

    # Muestra el resultado
    mainPanel(
      h4("Estimación basada en los parámetros actuales:"),
      textOutput("res"),
      br(),
      verbatimTextOutput("res_2", placeholder = T),
      br(),
      h4("Duración del test"),
      textOutput("res_3"),
      br(),
      h4("Notas:"),
      h5("1. La aplicación calcula el parámetro que esté vacío"),
      h5("2. El tamaño de muestra proporcionado aplica para cada uno de los grupos (control y prueba)"),
      h5("3. La tasa de conversión y el cambio esperado están expresados porcentualmente"),
      h5("4. La potencia hace referencia a la capacidad de la prueba de encontrar una diferencia estadísticamente significativa, cuando esta existe."),
      h5(tags$img(src="hypo.png"))

    )
  )
))

Thanks

messages.subject: Re: How to create responsive images in Shiny App
messages.subject_clean: How to create responsive images in Shiny App
messages.body_plain:
You can include two img tags, one for each size; and each img tag can have a class indicating what screen sizes it should be displayed for.
https://getbootstrap.com/docs/3.3/css/#responsive-utilities

In this case you want class="visible-xs-inline" for the small one, and class="hidden-xs" for the larger one.

messages.subject_clean: Clearing the Search Data From 1st Iteration - R
messages.body_plain:
Hello,
Below is the problem i am facing with the R shiny Dashboard, Data point 3 and Data Point 4 is not applicable for the 2nd search instance, but 1st search instance data is retained.

Tips or Tricks to wipe all the data created by multiple functions, prior to initiate the 2nd search instance.

Thanks,
Praveen

Expected Result
  1st Search 2nd Search
  Applicability Applicability
Data Point 1 Yes Yes
Data Point 2 Yes Yes
On Request
Data Extract Data Point 3 Yes No
On Request
Data Extract Data Point 4 Yes No
Actual Results
  1st Search 2nd Search
  Applicability Applicability
Data Point 1 Yes Yes
Data Point 2 Yes Yes
On Request
Data Extract Data Point 3 Yes Yes - Data from First Search
On Request
Data Extract Data Point 4 Yes Yes - Data from First Search

messages.body_plain:
Hi,

I would be interested in this as well. I've started a discussion on SO <https://stackoverflow.com/a/53416200/1655567> that outlines the problem I want to address with this solution. The SO answers solves basics but there are still some glitches in a more complex application that I've. It would be good to have a working example of solutioning this properly with a module consisting of multiple interactive elements and elaborate interface.

Kind regards,
Konrad

On Wednesday, 21 June 2017 15:36:44 UTC+1, Jamie M. Kass wrote:
> Joe,
>
> Sorry for the late reply. Thanks so much for the tip -- it works beautifully. I finally get the difference between eventReactive() and observeEvent().
>
> It would be great if someone could include an addendum to the Shiny Modules page on the RStudio website to address this usage with actionButtons. I couldn't find any web resources that answered my question. Thanks again!
>
> Jamie
>
> On Thursday, 15 June 2017 18:40:19 UTC-4, Joe Cheng [RStudio] wrote:
> > Don't call callModule from inside observeEvent; keep it at the top level. Take the reactive expression that's returned, and use eventReactive to wrap it in the button click. And use the eventReactive from your outputs, etc.
> >
> > x <- callModule(...)
> > y <- eventReactive(input$go, x())
> > output$tbl <- DT::renderDataTable(y())
> > On Thu, Jun 15, 2017 at 1:21 AM Jamie M. Kass <ndimhy...@gmail.com> wrote:
> > > I have a much larger app that runs on reactiveValues() and other such not-so-great coding choices, and I have made the decision (inspired by Joe's talk in 2016) to rehaul it and work mostly with reactive functions and modules.
> > >
> > > I have hit a bump though. I was wondering what the proper method is for activating a module using an actionButton. I'd like the user to press an actionButton to confirm a text input, and this retrieves the reactive output of a module. Most (all?) of the module examples are very simple and just plot stuff -- I want my modules to be activated with buttons, and that requires some tricky usage of observeEvent() -- unless I am out of my element here.
> > >
> > > I boiled down my example below. The first ("modular") works, but the table updates whenever the text is changed. When I remove modularity ("unModularized"), everything works fine -- the table only updates when the button is pressed. I must be missing something fundamental.
> > >
> > > If this is the wrong (or inadvisable) way to approach modules, please tell me what to do to make it better. Thanks for your help.
> > >
> > > modular
> > >
> > > formatName <- function(n) paste(strsplit(n, split=' ')[[1]], collapse='_')
> > >
> > > # UI part of the module
> > > queryDB_UI <- function(id) {
> > >   ns <- NS(id)
> > >   tagList(
> > >     textInput(ns("name"), label = "Input name")
> > >   )
> > > }
> > >
> > > queryDB <- function(input, output, session, spName) {
> > >
> > >   query <- reactive({
> > >     q <- spocc::occ(input$name)
> > >     # extract occurrence tibble
> > >     tbl <- q[['gbif']]$data[[formatName(input$name)]]
> > >     return(tbl)
> > >   })
> > >   return(query)
> > > }
> > >
> > >
> > > # UI
> > > ui <- fluidPage(
> > >   sidebarLayout(
> > >     sidebarPanel(
> > >       queryDB_UI('id1'),
> > >       actionButton("go", "Search")
> > >     ),
> > >     mainPanel(
> > >       DT::dataTableOutput('tbl')
> > >     )
> > >   )
> > > )
> > >
> > > # Server side
> > > server <- function(input, output, session){
> > >
> > >   observeEvent(input$go, {
> > >     x <- callModule(queryDB, 'id1', spName)
> > >     output$tbl <- DT::renderDataTable(x())
> > >   })
> > >
> > > }
> > >
> > > shinyApp(ui, server)
> > >
> > >
> > >
> > > unModularized
> > >
> > > formatName <- function(n) paste(strsplit(n, split=' ')[[1]], collapse='_')
> > >
> > > # UI part of the module
> > > queryDB_UI <- function(id) {

> > >   tagList(

> > > }

> > >     return(tbl)

> > >

messages.subject: Shiny app disconnects only on server--logs show no errors
messages.subject_clean: Shiny app disconnects only on server--logs show no errors
messages.body_plain:
I have a secure app hosted that disconnects very randomly and infrequently based on some user inputs.

The app looks at historical load data from a logistics company and uses this data to suggest the best companies to call based on the following input parameters:

Zip of Origin *
Zip of Destination *
Equipment Type *
Load Weight (lbs)
Total Amount to Bill
Date

*mandatory fields

For some combinations of zipcodes and equipment types the query will run fine, but when I click on the table to display a map of that companies recent routes, the app will disconnect without throwing any error at all (despite my best efforts to track these errors).

*due to sensitive data, I cannot post a working example (I would create a mock-up app, but then the problem would be non-existent since I am unable to replicate the disconnect)
